summary: The article accurately reports on the impact of Micron Technology's strong earnings on Asian stock markets, with specific figures for index movements largely consistent across multiple financial news sources. The context and implications for Indian investors are also well-explained.

claims.claim: South Korea's Kospi index surged over 5% at market open, while the small-cap Kosdaq gained 1.32%.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the Kospi surged over 5% at open. The Kosdaq gain is also consistent.

claims.claim: Japan's Nikkei 225 index also saw a significant rise, climbing by 1%.
claims.note: Livemint and other sources confirm the Nikkei 225 rose by at least 1%.

claims.claim: Micron Technology, a US-based semiconductor company specialising in memory and storage solutions, recently announced earnings that significantly exceeded market expectations.
claims.note: Micron Technology reported Q3 2026 earnings on June 23, 2026 (or June 24, 2026, depending on time zone of reporting), with EPS and revenue significantly exceeding analyst expectations.

claims.claim: Micron's fiscal year third-quarter (March–May) revenue was $41.46 billion (about 64 trillion won), up 345.7% from a year earlier. The operating margin was 81.2%.
claims.note: Micron's Q3 2026 revenue was reported as $41.46 billion, up 346% year-over-year. Adjusted EPS was $25.11. Operating margin was not explicitly stated as 81.2% in the immediate earnings reports, but gross margin was high.

claims.claim: Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) were $25.11, far exceeding the market consensus of $20.78.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm Micron's adjusted EPS was $25.11, beating consensus estimates.

article_title: Micron's Strong Earnings Drive Asian Stock Rally
